sentences.hanzi: 我的公寓里有两个卧室。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de gōngyù lǐ yǒu liǎng ge wòshì.

meaning.en: There are two bedrooms in my apartment.
meaning.fr: Il y a deux chambres dans mon appartement.

sentences.hanzi: 还有一个厨房、一个卫生间和一个客厅。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu yí ge chúfáng, yí ge wèishēngjiān hé yí ge kètīng.

meaning.en: There is also a kitchen, a bathroom and a living room.
meaning.fr: Il y a aussi une cuisine, une salle de bains et un salon.
meaning.ru: Также есть кухня, ванная и гостиная.
meaning.tr: Ayrıca bir mutfak, bir banyo ve bir oturma odası var.

sentences.hanzi: 我的房间里有一张床、一张桌子和两把椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān lǐ yǒu yì zhāng chuáng, yì zhāng zhuōzi hé liǎng bǎ yǐzi.

meaning.en: My room has a bed, a desk and two chairs.
meaning.fr: Dans ma chambre, il y a un lit, un bureau et deux chaises.
meaning.ru: В моей комнате кровать, стол и два стула.
meaning.tr: Odamda bir yatak, bir masa ve iki sandalye var.

meaning.en: Do you want to rent a place?

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yào zū fáng, bú shì zū chē.

meaning.en: I want to rent a home, not a car.
meaning.fr: Je veux louer un logement, pas une voiture.
meaning.ru: Я хочу снять жильё, а не арендовать машину.

meaning.en: I would like to take a taxi.

sentences.pinyin: Xiān kǎo jiàshǐzhèng, zài kāi chē.

meaning.en: First get a driver’s licence, then drive.
meaning.fr: Passe d’abord le permis, puis conduis.
meaning.ru: Сначала получи права, потом води машину.
meaning.tr: Önce ehliyet al, sonra araba sür.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ liù diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng.

meaning.fr: Je prends le petit-déjeuner à 6 h 50.
Je viens à l’école à 7 h 30.

sentences.pinyin: Shí’èr diǎn yí kè chī wǔfàn.

meaning.en: I also have class in the afternoon.
meaning.ru: После обеда у меня тоже занятия.

sentences.pinyin: Xià kè hòu wǒ zuò zuòyè.

meaning.fr: Après le cours, je fais mes devoirs.
meaning.ru: После уроков я делаю домашнее задание.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上六点我坐地铁回家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang liù diǎn wǒ zuò dìtiě huí jiā.

meaning.en: At 6 p.m. I take the metro home.
meaning.fr: À 18 heures, je rentre en métro.
meaning.ru: В шесть вечера я еду домой на метро.

sentences.hanzi: 回家后我吃晚饭，复习汉语。
sentences.pinyin: Huí jiā hòu wǒ chī wǎnfàn, fùxí Hànyǔ.

meaning.en: After getting home, I have dinner and review Chinese.
meaning.fr: Après mon retour, je dîne et révise le chinois.
meaning.ru: Вернувшись домой, я ужинаю и повторяю китайский.
meaning.tr: Eve döndükten sonra akşam yemeği yer, Çince tekrar ederim.

sentences.hanzi: 我大概晚上十一点睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dàgài wǎnshang shíyī diǎn shuì jiào.

meaning.en: I go to bed at about 11 p.m.
meaning.ru: Я ложусь спать примерно в одиннадцать вечера.
meaning.tr: Gece saat on bir civarında yatarım.

meaning.en: Excuse me, where is the bank?
The bank is east of the bookshop.
meaning.fr: La banque est à l’est de la librairie.
meaning.ru: Банк к востоку от книжного магазина.

meaning.en: The dormitory buildings are all in the north.
meaning.fr: Les résidences sont toutes au nord.

sentences.hanzi: 一号楼、二号楼在前边，三号楼、四号楼在后边。
sentences.pinyin: Yī hào lóu, èr hào lóu zài qiánbian, sān hào lóu, sì hào lóu zài hòubian.

meaning.en: Buildings 1 and 2 are in front; 3 and 4 are behind.
meaning.fr: Les bâtiments 1 et 2 sont devant ; les 3 et 4 sont derrière.
meaning.ru: Здания 1 и 2 спереди, а 3 и 4 сзади.
meaning.tr: 1 ve 2 numaralı binalar önde, 3 ve 4 arkada.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de sùshè zài sì hào lóu.

meaning.en: My dorm room is in Building 4.
meaning.fr: Ma chambre est dans le bâtiment 4.
meaning.ru: Моя комната в общежитии в здании 4.

meaning.en: The bookshop is west of the bank.
meaning.fr: La librairie est à l’ouest de la banque.
meaning.ru: Книжный магазин к западу от банка.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān xià yǔ, wǒ yòng yǔsǎn.

meaning.en: It is raining today; I use an umbrella.
meaning.fr: Il pleut aujourd’hui ; j’utilise un parapluie.
meaning.ru: Сегодня идёт дождь, я пользуюсь зонтом.

meaning.fr: J’ai commandé un repas à livrer.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zhǎo wǒ shí kuài qián.

meaning.en: Please give me ten yuan in change.
meaning.fr: Rendez-moi dix yuans, s’il vous plaît.
meaning.ru: Дайте мне, пожалуйста, десять юаней сдачи.
meaning.tr: Lütfen on yuan para üstü verin.

sentences.pinyin: Dōngbian de nà zuò lóu shì yínháng.

meaning.en: That building on the east side is the bank.
meaning.fr: Le bâtiment à l’est est la banque.
meaning.ru: То здание с восточной стороны — банк.

meaning.en: I do not need a taxi.
meaning.fr: Je n’ai pas besoin de taxi.
Je vais à l’école à pied.

meaning.en: I ride an e-bike to school.
meaning.fr: Je vais à l’école à vélo électrique.
meaning.ru: Я еду в школу на электровелосипеде.

meaning.fr: Je rentre chez moi en bus.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dǎ chē, bù xiǎng zū chē.

meaning.en: I want to get a taxi, not rent a car.
meaning.fr: Je veux prendre un taxi, pas louer une voiture.
meaning.ru: Я хочу вызвать такси, а не арендовать машину.
meaning.tr: Taksi çağırmak istiyorum, araba kiralamak istemiyorum.

meaning.en: We take the high-speed train to Shanghai.
meaning.fr: Nous allons à Shanghai en train à grande vitesse.
meaning.ru: Мы едем в Шанхай на скоростном поезде.

meaning.en: I ride a bicycle to the bookshop.
meaning.fr: Je vais à la librairie à vélo.
meaning.ru: Я еду в книжный магазин на велосипеде.

meaning.fr: Je rentre chez moi en taxi.

meaning.en: I book an app-based ride to school.
meaning.fr: Je réserve une voiture avec une application pour aller à l’école.
meaning.ru: Я заказываю поездку в школу через приложение.
meaning.tr: Okula gitmek için uygulamadan araç çağırırım.

meaning.en: I take the train to Shanghai.
meaning.fr: Je vais à Shanghai en train.
meaning.ru: Я еду в Шанхай на поезде.

meaning.fr: Je vais à Shanghai en avion.
meaning.ru: Я лечу в Шанхай на самолёте.

meaning.fr: Je vais à l’école en voiture, au volant.
meaning.ru: Я сам веду машину в школу.

meaning.en: I rent a car for a trip.
meaning.fr: Je loue une voiture pour voyager.

meaning.en: The bank is to the east.

sentences.hanzi: 这是书店，东边的那座楼是银行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì shūdiàn, dōngbian de nà zuò lóu shì yínháng.

meaning.en: This is the bookshop; the building east of it is the bank.
meaning.fr: Voici la librairie ; le bâtiment à l’est est la banque.
meaning.ru: Это книжный магазин; здание к востоку от него — банк.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì shūdiàn, nà shì yínháng.

meaning.en: This is the bookshop; that is the bank.
meaning.fr: Voici la librairie ; là-bas, c’est la banque.
meaning.ru: Это книжный магазин, а то — банк.

sentences.hanzi: 那座楼是四号楼，我的宿舍在四号楼。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zuò lóu shì sì hào lóu, wǒ de sùshè zài sì hào lóu.

meaning.en: That is Building 4; my dorm room is in Building 4.
meaning.fr: C’est le bâtiment 4 ; ma chambre y est.
meaning.ru: Это здание № 4; моя комната в нём.
meaning.tr: O bina 4 numaralı bina; yurt odam orada.

meaning.en: The school is south of the dormitory.
meaning.fr: L’école est au sud de la résidence.
meaning.ru: Школа находится к югу от общежития.

meaning.en: Excuse me, where is the bank?

sentences.pinyin: Wàimian xià yǔ le, dài yǔsǎn ba.

meaning.en: It is raining outside; take an umbrella.
meaning.fr: Il pleut dehors ; emporte un parapluie.
meaning.ru: На улице пошёл дождь; возьми зонт.
meaning.tr: Dışarıda yağmur yağıyor; yanına şemsiye al.

meaning.en: I want to order food delivery.
meaning.fr: Je veux commander un repas à livrer.
meaning.ru: Я хочу заказать еду с доставкой.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de qián.

meaning.en: I am looking for my money.

sentences.pinyin: Wàimian xià yǔ le, wǒ dài yǔsǎn.

meaning.en: It is raining outside; I take an umbrella.
meaning.fr: Il pleut dehors ; je prends un parapluie.
meaning.ru: На улице пошёл дождь; я беру зонт.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng qiān kuài qián.

provenance.note: Core home/day material from supplied PDF; campus/locality from textbook photos; route and linking examples are labelled additions. No photographs or personal images are published. The campus is a teaching diagram, not a real geographic map.
